The model Hamiltonian and interaction require separate material validation.
answer: At 1160.45 K, the accepted model gives a larger singlet pairing eigenvalue (0.05518) than triplet (0.007483), favoring singlet pairing within this calculation. These model results do not establish material superconductivity or a superconducting transition temperature.
